fieldData.main-content:
The Radix Chess Club is now in full swing. Since launching, 125 members have joined and are ready for battle!

The first tournament will be held on the 31st of March via Lichess.com.

If you have not yet joined please do so now Here. You can arrange games any time, or wait for the pre-arranged competitions. 

This initiative is being led by one of our newest Radvocates, gpel33, a Chess Master and passionate Radix supporter.

Gpel33 will be assisting us to arrange monthly online tournaments to find the greatest chess player in the Radix community. Our champion will be flared as such in Telegram, until such time their crown is taken by another! In the coming weeks, RDX Works may also nominate a representative to play the Community Champion…

Once Babylon launches, the reigning chess champion will be issued a “Chess Championship Belt” NFT, which they will pass onto the next champion if defeated, creating a lineal champion, adding provenance to the belt, and establishing a long-running and competitive aspect to the community.   

Please follow the registration details below. We will provide updates for future events via the Chess Club Telegram.

The Event‍

Time: 18:30 - 20:00 UTC 

Date: 31st March 2022

Venue: Online at Lichess.com

How to Register:

  • Join the Radix Chess Club Telegram
  • Register an account with Lichess. 
  • Go to https://lichess.org/team/radix-chess-club
  • Enter password: top1minimum
  • See full Tournament Competition Terms and Conditions

Prizes: 

  • 1st - $100 of XRD
  • 2nd - $80 of XRD
  • 3rd- $60 of XRD
  • 5 participants will be selected at random to receive $20 XRD

‍

Let the games begin!
